title: MDX autolink lint: the remedy drops the bare-URL arm and reads exactly "use [text](url)" (DEC-172 (4bi) amending (4at))
description:
Filed by lore-cli's session from opum-doc DEC-172 (4bi), which amends (4at). (4at) pinned the MDX autolink finding's remedy to "use [text](url) or a bare URL"; (4bi) DROPS the bare-URL arm. The reason: a bare URL autolinks only where GFM autolink literals render (GitHub, Obsidian) and renders as PLAIN TEXT in the scaffolded MkDocs/Material config, while [text](url) renders as a link everywhere — a remedy has to produce a working link wherever the page renders, and [text](url) is the only form that does. The shipped doc (docs/reference/portable-markdown.md) already says so.

Detection is UNCHANGED (4bi is explicit): the angle-bracket autolink is still flagged, and a bare URL and a [text](url) link are still NOT flagged (the positive control). Scope: the finding message text (src/core/check.ts, the autolinkHazard helper) and a test that pins it. Not the detection, not the docs' detection sections.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The portability autolink finding's message names exactly "use [text](url)" as the remedy, with no bare-URL arm (the string "or a bare URL" no longer appears in it).
Detection is unchanged: the angle-bracket autolink is still flagged, and a bare URL and a [text](url) link are still not flagged (the positive control).
A test pins the message text (it asserts the remedy is [text](url) and that no bare-URL arm is offered).

implementationNotes:
Implemented DEC-172 (4bi), which amends (4at). The angle-bracket autolink finding's message (`src/core/check.ts`, the `autolinkHazard` helper) now reads exactly "use [text](url)" — the bare-URL arm is dropped, because a bare URL renders as PLAIN TEXT in the scaffolded MkDocs/Material config (no autolink extension) while `[text](url)` renders as a link wherever the page does.

Detection is UNCHANGED, as (4bi) is explicit: the angle-bracket autolink is still flagged, and a bare URL and a `[text](url)` link are still NOT flagged (the positive control, covered by the existing tests). Only the remedy wording moves.

`test/check.test.ts` now pins the remedy BOTH ways: the finding message CONTAINS "use [text](url)" and does NOT contain "bare URL". `docs/reference/portable-markdown.md`'s remedy bullet and the CHANGELOG's LCLI-701 entry (still [Unreleased], so editable) both stop offering a bare URL as a repair and say why.

Gates: `bun test` 5008 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail; `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lore check` (exit 0) all green.
finalSummary: DEC-172 (4bi), amending (4at): the MDX autolink finding's remedy now reads exactly "use [text](url)"; the bare-URL arm is dropped, because a bare URL is plain text in the scaffolded MkDocs/Material config while [text](url) renders as a link wherever the page does. Detection is unchanged — the autolink is still flagged and the bare and [text](url) forms are still not (the positive control). test/check.test.ts pins the message both ways; docs/reference/portable-markdown.md and the CHANGELOG's LCLI-701 entry stop offering a bare URL. Gates green: bun test 5008 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail, lint, typecheck, lore check exit 0. Delivered under opum-control job-17351a2.
